title: Přihláška pojištěnce (protected, AES-256)
models: The prihlaska-pojistence form protected as VZP's fill-in forms are: AES-256 (V5, R6), an owner password only, permissions to print in high quality, add annotations, fill in form fields and extract for accessibility (P -1052). It must be read and filled like the unprotected form, and its copy must carry the same protection.
